question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 13 and 17 days respectively. A begins to do the work, and they work alternatively one at a time for one day each. The whole work will be completed in:
solution:
**Given:**

Time in which A can complete a piece of work = 13 days

Time in which B can complete a piece of work = 17 days

**Concept used:**

L.C.M. of 13 and 17 = 221

Thus, total work done = 221 units.

Unit of work done by A in 1 day = 17 units

Unit of work done by B in 1 day = 13 units

**Calculation:**

If A and B work alternatively, work done by them in 2 days = 30 units

Work done in 14 days = 30 × 7 = 210 units

Work left = 11 units

Work done remaining by A on 15th day = 11 over 17 

Thus, the time taken to complete the work = 1411 over 17 days.

**∴ The whole work will be completed in 14bf 11 over 17 days.**
